# Rooftop LED Lightbar Installation

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

Soak roof airdam bolts, remove knee panel openings, and mount the lightbar with longer M6 bolts if needed. [t167]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Soak roof airdam bolts with penetrating oil 24 hours in advance to ensure smooth removal.
2. Remove the three covered openings on the driver side knee panel using a rasp or reamer for switch fitment.
3. Replace small connectors on the wiring harness switch with larger receivers to attach securely to the rocker switch.
4. [Partial] Pull power wire from the passenger side fuse box and integrate it into the driver side rocker switch circuit.
5. Mount the lightbar brackets, noting that M6 1x40 length hex head bolts are needed if rubber pads sit higher than a standard thread depth.
6. Run wiring externally down the passenger side windshield using RTV sealant on the underside and black silicone to fill exposed tops for concealment.
7. Apply weather-proofing electrical tape with an additional wrap of standard tape over light switch connectors near the brake booster.
8. [Partial] Fill the Xterra airdam base holes with silicon and apply blue Loctite to bolts to prevent leaks.

_Procedure reported by [t167]._

## Specifications

- **Bolt length for high-mounted brackets**: 1x40 (M6 hex head) [t167] ([Partial] [Unverified] single report)
- **Lightbar size**: 40 inch Curved Double Row LED [t167] ([Unverified] single report)

## Tips & gotchas

- Run wire back up from roof along passenger side windscreen using KC rubber strip for external installation. [t167]
- Replace small pre-fab harness connectors with larger receivers to attach properly onto the rocker switch. [t167]
- [Partial] Ground the system inside the fender adjacent to the corner of the passenger side battery. [t167]

## Common mistakes

- [Partial] Using standard bolt lengths that were too short because brackets with rubber pads sat higher than expected. [t167]
- [Partial] Using standard 30mm bolts when brackets sit higher than expected. [t167]
